versions.changelog:
- Scope clarification: Skill is now explicitly limited to resumes/CVs and not general Persian documents.
- Added a README.md for better project documentation.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.
- Improved SKILL.md for clarity, scope alignment, and conciseness.
- Updated generation and validation scripts for consistency with the refined specification.

Initial release of persian-resume skill:

- Generates professional Persian (RTL) resumes/CVs, handling mixed Persian-English content with correct rendering and layout.
- Supports creating new resumes from user info or transforming/polishing existing Persian resumes, including fixing RTL/bidi issues.
- Provides two templates: classic (single-column) and modern (two-column sidebar), with guidance on when to use each.
- Enforces strict separation from general Persian documents; for non-resume documents, use persian-documents instead.
- Includes detailed resume structure, formatting, and content guidelines to ensure professional, correctly ordered output in PDF or DOCX format.
